books.name: Genesis
books.author: Moses (traditionally)
books.date: Events from creation to about 1800 BC; written c. 1400s BC
books.theme: God creates, judges, and begins a people through Abraham.

keyVerse.text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

books.christConnection: The promised offspring who will crush the serpent (Genesis 3:15) points to Christ.

books.name: Exodus
books.author: Moses (traditionally)
books.theme: God redeems Israel from slavery and makes them his people at Sinai.

keyVerse.text: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

books.christConnection: The Passover lamb and the exodus point to Jesus, our Redeemer.

books.name: Leviticus
books.author: Moses (traditionally)
books.theme: A holy God makes a way for a sinful people to live near him.

keyVerse.text: Be holy because I, the Lord your God, am holy.

books.christConnection: The sacrifices and the priesthood point to Christ's once-for-all offering.

books.name: Numbers
books.author: Moses (traditionally)
books.theme: God leads Israel through the wilderness, in their wandering and his faithfulness.

keyVerse.text: The Lord bless you and keep you.

books.christConnection: The bronze snake (Numbers 21) points to Christ lifted up for our healing.

books.name: Deuteronomy
books.author: Moses (traditionally)
books.theme: Moses retells the law and calls Israel to love the Lord with all their heart.

keyVerse.text: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

books.christConnection: Jesus is the faithful Israelite who loved God perfectly and is the prophet like Moses.

books.name: Joshua
books.author: Joshua (traditionally)
books.theme: God keeps his promise and brings Israel into the land.

keyVerse.text: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.

books.christConnection: Joshua (whose name means 'the Lord saves') points to Jesus, who brings his people into rest.

books.name: Judges
books.author: Samuel (traditionally)
books.theme: Israel cycles through sin, oppression, crying out, and God's rescue.

keyVerse.text: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.

books.christConnection: The need for a true, righteous King is met in Christ.

books.name: Ruth
books.author: Samuel (traditionally)
books.theme: God's kindness works through ordinary faithfulness in the line of David.

keyVerse.text: Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.

books.christConnection: Boaz the kinsman-redeemer points to Christ; Ruth stands in the Messiah's family line.

books.name: 1 Samuel
books.author: Samuel / later prophets (traditionally)
books.theme: God raises up Samuel, Saul, and David, and looks at the heart.

keyVerse.text: People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.

books.christConnection: David, the anointed king after God's heart, points to Christ the greater King.

books.name: 2 Samuel
books.author: Samuel / later prophets (traditionally)
books.theme: David's reign, his sin, and God's covenant promise of an everlasting throne.

keyVerse.text: Your house and your kingdom will endure forever before me; your throne will be established forever.

books.christConnection: The Davidic covenant is fulfilled in Jesus, Son of David.

books.name: 1 Kings
books.author: Jeremiah (traditionally)
books.theme: Solomon's glory, the divided kingdom, and the call to listen to God's word.

keyVerse.text: The heavens, even the highest heaven, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!

books.christConnection: The temple points to Jesus, who is God with us, and to his people as God's dwelling.

books.name: 2 Kings
books.author: Jeremiah (traditionally)
books.theme: The kingdoms fall; God remains faithful even in exile.

keyVerse.text: The Lord warned Israel and Judah through all his prophets and seers: 'Turn from your evil ways.'

books.christConnection: The failed kings highlight our need for a perfect King, Jesus.

books.name: 1 Chronicles
books.author: Ezra (traditionally)
books.theme: A priestly retelling of Israel's story, centered on worship and David's line.

keyVerse.text: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.

books.christConnection: The careful record of David's line leads to Christ.

books.name: 2 Chronicles
books.author: Ezra (traditionally)
books.theme: The temple, revival, and the hope of return after judgment.

keyVerse.text: If my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.

books.christConnection: True temple worship is fulfilled in Christ.

books.name: Ezra
books.author: Ezra (traditionally)
books.theme: God brings a remnant home and restores worship around his Word.

keyVerse.text: Ezra had devoted himself to the study and observance of the Law of the Lord, and to teaching its decrees and laws in Israel.

books.christConnection: The restored worship and the remnant prepare the way for the Messiah.

books.name: Nehemiah
books.author: Nehemiah (traditionally)
books.theme: God uses Nehemiah to rebuild the wall and call the people back to the Word.

keyVerse.text: The joy of the Lord is your strength.

books.christConnection: Rebuilding and reform point to Christ, who builds his church.

books.name: Esther
books.author: Unknown (traditionally Mordecai or a court recorder)
books.theme: God quietly preserves his people in Persia when they seem forgotten.

keyVerse.text: And who knows but that you have come to your royal position for such a time as this?

books.christConnection: God's hidden providence to save his people points to Christ, who came 'for such a time as this.'

books.name: Job
books.author: Unknown (traditionally Moses or a later sage)
books.theme: A righteous sufferer wrestles with God and finds that God is wise and good.

keyVerse.text: I know that my redeemer lives, and that in the end he will stand on the earth.

books.christConnection: Job's living Redeemer is fulfilled in the risen Christ.

books.name: Psalms
books.author: David and others (traditionally, with later compilers)
books.theme: Songs of prayer and praise for every season of the soul.

keyVerse.text: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.

books.christConnection: Many psalms speak of the righteous sufferer and the promised King; Jesus is both.

books.name: Proverbs
books.author: Solomon and others (traditionally)
books.theme: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom for everyday life.

keyVerse.text: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

books.christConnection: Christ is the wisdom of God, in whom these sayings find their fullness.

books.name: Ecclesiastes
books.author: Solomon (traditionally)
books.theme: Life 'under the sun' is empty unless we fear God and keep his commands.

keyVerse.text: Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the duty of all mankind.

books.christConnection: The emptiness of life without God drives us to Christ, our true meaning.

books.name: Song of Songs
books.author: Solomon (traditionally)
books.theme: A joyful, faithful picture of marital love as a gift from God.

keyVerse.text: My beloved is mine and I am his.

books.christConnection: Faithful marriage love also pictures Christ's love for his church.

books.name: Isaiah
books.author: Isaiah
books.theme: The Holy One of Israel judges sin and promises a coming Servant-King.

keyVerse.text: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders.

books.christConnection: Isaiah's Servant and the child called Mighty God are fulfilled in Jesus.

books.name: Jeremiah
books.author: Jeremiah
books.theme: God judges Judah and promises a new covenant written on the heart.

keyVerse.text: I will put my law in their minds and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

books.christConnection: The new covenant is sealed in Jesus' blood.

books.name: Lamentations
books.author: Jeremiah (traditionally)
books.theme: Honest grief after Jerusalem falls, with hope in God's mercies.

keyVerse.text: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.

books.christConnection: God's mercies in the ruins point to the comfort found in Christ.

books.name: Ezekiel
books.author: Ezekiel
books.theme: God is still present in exile and promises a new heart and a new temple.

keyVerse.text: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you.

books.christConnection: The new heart and the river from the temple point to the Spirit given by Christ.

books.name: Daniel
books.author: Daniel
books.theme: God rules the nations; his kingdom will never be destroyed.

keyVerse.text: His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and his kingdom is one that will never be destroyed.

books.christConnection: The Son of Man who receives the kingdom is Jesus.

books.name: Hosea
books.author: Hosea
books.theme: God's faithful love pursues an unfaithful people.

keyVerse.text: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and acknowledgment of God rather than burnt offerings.

books.christConnection: Hosea's costly love for Gomer pictures Christ pursuing his unfaithful people.

books.name: Joel
books.author: Joel
books.date: Uncertain (often placed in the 800s or 400s BC)
books.theme: A locust plague becomes a call to repent and a promise of the Spirit.

keyVerse.text: Rend your heart and not your garments. Return to the Lord your God, for he is gracious and compassionate.

books.christConnection: The promised Spirit is poured out at Pentecost (Acts 2).

books.name: Amos
books.author: Amos
books.theme: God calls for justice and true worship, not empty religion.

keyVerse.text: But let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!

books.christConnection: The demand for righteousness is met, and will be completed, in Christ.

books.name: Obadiah
books.author: Obadiah
books.theme: God judges Edom's pride and promises that the kingdom will be the Lord's.

keyVerse.text: The day of the Lord is near for all nations.

books.christConnection: The coming Day of the Lord is fulfilled in Christ's first and second coming.

books.name: Jonah
books.author: Jonah (traditionally)
books.theme: God's compassion reaches even Nineveh, and he is patient with a reluctant prophet.

keyVerse.text: Salvation comes from the Lord.

books.christConnection: Jesus is the greater Jonah, three days in the heart of the earth (Matthew 12:40).

books.name: Micah
books.author: Micah
books.theme: God requires justice, mercy, and humility, and promises a ruler from Bethlehem.

keyVerse.text: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will be ruler over Israel.

books.christConnection: The Bethlehem ruler is Jesus.

books.name: Nahum
books.author: Nahum
books.theme: God is slow to anger, yet he will not leave the guilty unpunished.

keyVerse.text: The Lord is good, a refuge in times of trouble. He cares for those who trust in him.

books.christConnection: Judgment on evil and refuge for those who trust him are both found in Christ.

books.name: Habakkuk
books.author: Habakkuk
books.theme: A prophet asks why God allows injustice, and learns to live by faith.

keyVerse.text: The righteous person will live by his faithfulness.

books.christConnection: Paul cites this verse for justification by faith in Christ (Romans 1:17).

books.name: Zephaniah
books.author: Zephaniah
books.theme: The Day of the Lord is near; God will judge and then rejoice over his people.

keyVerse.text: The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing.

books.christConnection: God's delight over his gathered people is secured in Christ.

books.name: Haggai
books.author: Haggai
books.theme: God calls the returned exiles to put his house first.

keyVerse.text: The glory of this present house will be greater than the glory of the former house.

books.christConnection: The greater glory comes in Jesus, who is God present with his people.

books.name: Zechariah
books.author: Zechariah
books.theme: Visions of cleansing, a humble King, and the Lord coming to his people.

keyVerse.text: See, your king comes to you, righteous and victorious, lowly and riding on a donkey.

books.christConnection: Palm Sunday fulfills this promise in Jesus.

books.name: Malachi
books.author: Malachi
books.theme: God still loves his people and promises a messenger before the Lord comes.

keyVerse.text: I will send my messenger, who will prepare the way before me.

books.christConnection: John the Baptist prepares the way for Jesus.

books.name: Matthew
books.author: Matthew
books.theme: Jesus is the promised Messiah, the Son of David who fulfills the Scriptures.

keyVerse.text: She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.

books.christConnection: The whole Gospel presents Jesus as Christ the King.

books.name: Mark
books.author: Mark (with Peter's testimony, traditionally)
books.theme: Jesus is the suffering Son of God who came not to be served but to serve.

keyVerse.text: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.

books.christConnection: Mark leads us to the cross and the empty tomb of Jesus.

books.name: Luke
books.author: Luke
books.theme: Jesus is the Savior of all kinds of people, announced with joy and historical care.

keyVerse.text: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.

books.christConnection: Luke tells the story of the Savior for the world.

books.name: John
books.author: John
books.theme: Jesus is the eternal Word made flesh, the Son who gives life.

keyVerse.text: But these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.

books.christConnection: John's purpose is faith in Jesus the Son.

books.name: Acts
books.author: Luke
books.theme: The risen Jesus sends his Spirit and his church to the ends of the earth.

keyVerse.text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.

books.christConnection: Acts is the risen Christ's ongoing work through his church.

books.name: Romans
books.author: Paul
books.theme: The gospel of God's righteousness given by grace through faith in Christ.

keyVerse.text: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes.

books.christConnection: Romans explains the saving work of Jesus from start to finish.

books.name: 1 Corinthians
books.author: Paul
books.theme: The gospel shapes a messy church into a holy, loving body.

keyVerse.text: Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures.

books.christConnection: The cross and resurrection are the church's center.

books.name: 2 Corinthians
books.author: Paul
books.theme: God's power is shown in weakness, and ministry is a ministry of reconciliation.

keyVerse.text: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

books.christConnection: New creation is found in union with Christ.

books.name: Galatians
books.author: Paul
books.theme: We are justified by faith, not by works of the law, and called to walk by the Spirit.

keyVerse.text: A person is not justified by the works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ.

books.christConnection: Christ has set us free; we must not go back to earning favor.

books.name: Ephesians
books.author: Paul
books.theme: God's grace in Christ makes a new people, the church, for his glory.

keyVerse.text: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast.

books.christConnection: Union with Christ is the letter's heartbeat.

books.name: Philippians
books.author: Paul
books.theme: Joy in Christ, even in prison, and a call to have the mind of Christ.

keyVerse.text: In your relationships with one another, have the same mindset as Christ Jesus: Who, being in very nature God, did not consider equality with God something to be used to his own advantage; rather, he made himself nothing.

books.christConnection: Jesus' humility is our pattern and our salvation.

books.name: Colossians
books.author: Paul
books.theme: Christ is supreme over all, and we are complete in him.

keyVerse.text: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.

books.christConnection: Do not add to Christ; he is enough.

books.name: 1 Thessalonians
books.author: Paul
books.theme: Live in holiness and hope as you wait for Jesus' return.

keyVerse.text: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first. After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.

books.christConnection: The coming of Jesus is the church's living hope.

books.name: 2 Thessalonians
books.author: Paul
books.theme: Stand firm; do not be shaken by rumors about the Day of the Lord.

keyVerse.text: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father... encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.

books.christConnection: Christ will set all things right when he comes.

books.name: 1 Timothy
books.author: Paul
books.theme: Guard the gospel and order the church with godliness.

keyVerse.text: God's household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.

books.christConnection: The church is entrusted with the truth about Christ.

books.name: 2 Timothy
books.author: Paul
books.theme: Finish the race; the Scriptures are God-breathed and make you complete.

keyVerse.text: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness, so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.

books.christConnection: The sacred writings make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

books.name: Titus
books.author: Paul
books.theme: Sound doctrine produces a well-ordered, good life in the church and home.

keyVerse.text: For the grace of God has appeared that offers salvation to all people. It teaches us to say 'No' to ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright and godly lives in this present age.

books.christConnection: Grace trains us to live for the appearing of Christ.

books.name: Philemon
books.author: Paul
books.theme: The gospel turns a runaway slave and his owner into brothers in Christ.

keyVerse.text: So if you consider me a partner, welcome him as you would welcome me. If he has done you any wrong or owes you anything, charge it to me.

books.christConnection: Paul's offer to pay the debt pictures Christ's substitution.

books.name: Hebrews
books.author: Unknown (traditionally debated; not named in the letter)
books.theme: Jesus is better than every shadow in the old covenant.

keyVerse.text: In the past God spoke to our ancestors through the prophets at many times and in various ways, but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son.

books.christConnection: Christ is the final Word, the great High Priest, and the once-for-all sacrifice.

books.name: James
books.author: James, the brother of Jesus (traditionally)
books.theme: Genuine faith works itself out in a life of wisdom and love.

keyVerse.text: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.

books.christConnection: Faith in Christ is living, obedient faith.

books.name: 1 Peter
books.author: Peter
books.theme: Hope and holiness for exiles who follow a suffering, risen Christ.

keyVerse.text: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession.

books.christConnection: Christ suffered for you, leaving you an example.

books.name: 2 Peter
books.author: Peter
books.theme: Grow in grace; remember that the Lord will surely come.

keyVerse.text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

books.christConnection: Hold fast to the apostolic testimony about Jesus.

books.name: 1 John
books.author: John
books.theme: Those who belong to Jesus walk in the light, love the brothers, and believe the truth.

keyVerse.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.

books.christConnection: Fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

books.name: 2 John
books.author: John
books.theme: Walk in love and do not welcome teachers who deny that Jesus came in the flesh.

keyVerse.text: And this is love: that we walk in obedience to his commands.

books.christConnection: The truth about the incarnate Christ must be guarded.

books.name: 3 John
books.author: John
books.theme: Welcome faithful workers and copy what is good, not what is evil.

keyVerse.text: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

books.christConnection: Hospitality serves the mission of Christ.

books.name: Jude
books.author: Jude, the brother of Jesus (traditionally)
books.theme: Contend for the faith once for all entrusted to God's people.

keyVerse.text: To him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you before his glorious presence without fault and with great joy.

books.christConnection: Jesus keeps his people to the end.

books.name: Revelation
books.author: John
books.theme: The risen Christ rules, comforts his churches, and will make all things new.

keyVerse.text: He who was seated on the throne said, 'I am making everything new!'

books.christConnection: The Lamb who was slain is worthy, and he will return.
